fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' discharges an electric nova that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters ''Overcharged'' for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack will extend the duration by {{fd|2.5}} seconds, up to its original duration.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Overcharged:}} '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and an increased attack speed cap of {{as|{{ap|1.5+({{ccd|Zeri|as_ratio}}*0.3)}}|as}}. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' is empowered to have a 20% shorter cast time and a decreased spread angle, and instead fires 3 rounds that travel with increased speed. The first round to hit an enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} chains electricity to the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal {{as|40% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|40}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
fields.description3: During ''Overcharged'', '''Zeri''' can generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Hypercharged'' from enemy champions that last {{fd|2.5}} seconds. She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack, increased to 3 on abilities that {{tip|critically strike}}. Subsequent hits refresh the duration of ''Hypercharged''. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' grants stacks only against the first target hit.
fields.description4: {{sbc|Hypercharged:}} For each stack, '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|{{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
fields.description5: '''''Zeri''' can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.''
